name: ahn
description: When a web fetch or browser step is blocked or fails (403, login wall, CAPTCHA, 5xx, timeout), look up the hostname on Agent Help Network: the host's declared agent policy (robots.txt, llms.txt), the official developer path, provider status and published observations, with one recommended action. The hook is read-only and sends only the hostname and fixed codes. The bundled MCP server also offers report_observation, a write tool: use it only with the user's explicit approval, never automatically.
